summary: Kimi Antonelli inherits the Ferrari seat amid enormous pressure to deliver at Monza, where passionate tifosi must decide whether to back the rookie or demand the Scuderia's first championship in years. Pierre Gasly's Alpine shock pole position sets up a tactical chess match against Mercedes' superior straight-line speed, forcing Ferrari to navigate fuel strategy and DRS zones with surgical precision. A victory here would signal Antonelli's arrival as a title contender while keeping Ferrari's slim championship hopes alive against an increasingly dominant Mercedes outfit.
